maria.d: Proposal — add a lightweight deterministic probe ("probe-lite") into model onboarding fastpath to catch tokenization, layernorm/quant mismatch, and KV-cache boundary issues before heavy bench runs.

ajohnson: Nice. What are the perf tradeoffs? extra latency for every new model?
sachin: If probe-lite runs < 30s per model it's fine. What's the failure surface?
maria.d: Probe-lite checks: 1) tokenization hash vs expected, 2) small golden input pass/fail across seq len 8/64/512, 3) forward logits shape/NaN, 4) KV-save/load parity on short prefix, 5) embedding dim sanity. It returns structured verdict + short artifact.

elaine: How do we feed golden inputs? a manifest in model-registry? any schema?
maria.d: Yeah plan: model manifest field 'probe_golden' with list of inputs + expected tokenization_hash + tolerance. Example manifest:

```
probe_golden:
  - id: small-8
    text: "Hello world"
    tokenization_hash: "sha256:abcd..."
  - id: mid-64
    text: "Repeat this sentence to reach ~64 tokens..."
tokenizer: hf/xxx
expected_embedding_dim: 768
```

ajohnson: Implementation note: runtime should expose /smoke_probe endpoint that accepts model_version + manifest and runs on a pinned worker.
sachin: Also add a quick ABI check for quantized bins — detect mismatch by reading header bytes and comparing model-type tag.
maria.d: Failure modes -> non-deterministic outputs (flaky) should trigger rerun x2 then escalate. If probe flags quant/token mismatch, route model to 'slowpath' full bench and send auto-issue to model-intake queue.

elaine: Who owns the canary window? does this change onboarding SLA?
ajohnson: Keep SLA same; probe-lite runs within fastpath budget — we'll throttle concurrency. If we can't keep within 2m overall, we drop to async probe and continue.

ci-bot: New job created: eng-ml/probe-lite-smoke (runs on PRs to model-registry).
maria.d: Action items:
- @ajohnson: add /smoke_probe endpoint and pinned worker flag
- @sachin: define manifest schema + tokenization_hash tool
- @elaine: update onboarding playbook and rollout plan
I'll open an RFC follow-up doc and a small PoC PR. Thoughts? :thinking:
ajohnson: +1, ok to land PoC behind feature flag.
sachin: I'll draft schema tonight.
elaine: +1, add observability metrics (probe.duration, probe.verdict, probe.flakiness)
maria.d: cool, will post RFC link when ready. Thanks! :raised_hands:
